events.text: Hi, I'm locked out of my email. Can you reset my password?
I can help with that. To start, can you confirm your employee ID?

Before I give you anything, what exactly am I talking to? A person, a bot? Which AI
is it, and who's on the other end of this?

I'm an AI agent, not a person. I'm acting for the IT service desk at Halcyon Components. I can reset employee passwords, and the reset link is sent to the phone registered to your account. I don't know which underlying AI model I run on, and I can't see who else may have access to this conversation or whether it's recorded. If you'd rather speak to a person, the service desk is at extension 4400, 7am to 7pm.

When you're ready, please send your employee ID.
